newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine govt gets San Miguel board seat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine govt gets San Miguel board seat.

text.p: The Philippine government on Tuesday won an additonal seat on the 15-man board of food and beverage giant San Miguel Corp. It now has 11 seats.
The new appointee is Arturo Enrile, former armed forces chief who this week was also made Transportation and Communications Secretary.
He replaced Antonio Roxas, a representative of the private sector allied with Andres Soriano III, chairman and chief executive officer of San Miguel.
The government controls a 58 percent stake in the company.

Delfin Gonzales, chief finance officer of San Miguel, said the extra seat for the government representative was not as a result of an increased government stake but due to more proxy votes in their favour.
